# Contributing Guide

## Branch Strategy

- main
- develop
- feature/\*
- fix/\*
- release/\*
- hotfix/\*

---

## Commit Convention

```
feat(scope): message
fix(scope): message
docs(scope): message
refactor(scope): message
```

例如：

```
feat(auth): add login API
```

---

## Pull Request

所有功能皆需：

- 建立 Feature Branch
- Push 到 GitHub
- 建立 Pull Request
- Review
- Merge 到 develop

不得直接 Push 到 main。
